property_summary: For any inputs with a non-empty _tos array and a callee that reverts, the reference C always bubbles the revert (so the call to transfer reverts) while the mutant may instead return false when a callee call fails, thus producing a non-reverting false return value for some inputs.
change_summary: Change the require after the internal call to not revert on failed external call: replace require(_s) with if(!_s) return false; causing the function to return false when a callee call fails instead of reverting.
